title: Per-step evidence in the task file and a generated next action
goal: A task may carry prs [{pr, note}] and review; the steps table shows them and the PR / evidence cell lists them before the authored text; a 💻 line reading 'Next: from tasks.' gets the next open step as its sentence
acceptance: taskCatalog accepts and validates prs and review; the steps table gains an Evidence column; the PR / evidence cell is prefixed with the step evidence
'Next: from tasks.' is replaced by '<id> — <title>' of the first open step whose prerequisites are done, or 'All steps closed' when none is open; the authored cue kind is kept
Both BACKLOG-RULES copies: a step's PR, review and dates are recorded in its task file, so a step PR never edits the record; tests
privacy: Tool and rule text only; fixtures invented.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Judged 2026-11-12 from F-059/F-063: schema, two render points, one marker, tests. Estimate, not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-12, actual so far stated.
